patterns.title: Container crash loop (CrashLoopBackOff)
detection: containerStatuses[].state.waiting.reason == CrashLoopBackOff with rising restartCount
event BackOff "Back-off restarting failed container"; lastState.terminated.exitCode != 0
root_causes: missing env var / wrong Secret or ConfigMap (often in the wrong namespace)
bad command/entrypoint override or missing binary (exit 126/127)
failed startup migration or unreachable dependency at boot
memory limit too low (see pod-oomkilled, exit 137)
liveness probe too aggressive for a slow starter (see pod-probe-failing)
image regression introduced by the latest rollout

remediation.when: the crash cause looks transient (dependency was down, node hiccup) and other replicas are healthy
pods across the workload are stuck after a ConfigMap/Secret or dependency fix
failures began with the newest revision and the previous ReplicaSet was healthy
logs show a missing env var, file, or config key
exit code indicates an application bug that no restart will fix

patterns.verification: restartCount stable for >=5 min; READY n/n; rollout status Complete
patterns.notes: Dies before logging -> entrypoint/permissions/image; logs show an exception -> application/config. A restart only helps when the cause was transient.

patterns.title: Container OOMKilled (exit 137)
detection: lastState.terminated.reason == OOMKilled or exitCode 137 with rising restartCount
container_memory_working_set_bytes approaching the memory limit
root_causes: memory limit below the real working set (undersized from day one)
memory leak in the application (JVM heap, Node.js, Python caches)
runtime heap not sized to the cgroup limit
traffic spike / batch job with larger input
node-level OOM killing BestEffort pods that have no requests

remediation.when: OOM recurs across restarts and the limit is clearly below observed usage; raise by ~1.5x with a cap
load is spread unevenly and more replicas would lower per-pod memory
a single OOM after a known one-off spike; do not repeat if it recurs
usage grows linearly over time (leak) - a code fix is needed

patterns.verification: no new OOMKilled terminations for 30 min; working set < 80% of the limit
patterns.notes: Guaranteed QoS needs cpu AND memory request==limit for EVERY container. Autoscaling does not help when every replica is starved (Node.js at 128Mi case). CoreDNS itself being OOMKilled is a recurring k8s.af story.

patterns.title: Image pull failure (ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull)
detection: waiting.reason in ImagePullBackOff, ErrImagePull, InvalidImageName
event Failed "Failed to pull image" with unauthorized / manifest unknown / not found / timeout
root_causes: wrong tag or tag never pushed (image-or-tag-not-found)
missing or wrong-namespace imagePullSecret; expired registry credential (registry-auth)
registry rate limit (Docker Hub) or TLS trust problem
OpenShift internal registry unavailable or without storage
diagnostics: kubectl describe pod <pod> | grep -A3 -i "failed to pull"

remediation.when: cause is registry-unreachable or registry-rate-limit (transient); forces an immediate retry
cause is image-or-tag-not-found and the previous revision pulled fine
cause is image-or-tag-not-found / invalid-image-name / registry-auth
registry credentials or network must be fixed by a human

patterns.verification: pod Running and Ready; status.containerStatuses[].imageID populated
patterns.notes: Usually not an application problem. Mutable tags (:latest) cause split-brain rollouts; pin by digest.

patterns.title: Missing ConfigMap / Secret reference (CreateContainerConfigError)
detection: waiting.reason == CreateContainerConfigError or CreateContainerError
message 'configmap "x" not found' / 'secret "x" not found' / "couldn't find key"
root_causes: ConfigMap/Secret not deployed or deployed to another namespace
key name mismatch (optional=false)

remediation.when: the referenced object now exists (kubelet retries, but a restart is immediate)
the newest revision added the broken reference
the object truly does not exist; contents must come from a human

patterns.verification: container leaves the waiting state; READY n/n
patterns.notes: Same class as FailedMount "configmap not found" for projected volumes.

patterns.title: Pod Pending - scheduler cannot place it
detection: phase Pending; condition PodScheduled=False reason Unschedulable

detection.event FailedScheduling \"0/N nodes are a: Insufficient cpu|memory|nvidia.com/gpu", "untolerated taint", "didn't match node affinity/selector", "Too many pods"

root_causes: requests larger than any node's allocatable (or GPUs all reserved)
taints without tolerations; nodeSelector label absent; impossible required affinity
cluster-autoscaler not adding nodes (max size, no matching node group)
nodes cordoned / under pressure; per-node pod or IP limit reached
ResourceQuota exhausted (surfaces as workload-replica-failure)
diagnostics: kubectl get nodes -o wide; kubectl get nodes -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,TAINTS:.spec.taints

remediation.when: cause is nodes-cordoned and the node is otherwise Ready
temporarily lowering replicas of a lower-priority workload frees capacity (operator decision)
cause is insufficient-cpu/memory/gpu or no-nodes
cause is taint/affinity/selector mismatch - manifests must change

patterns.notes: Deleting a Pending pod changes nothing. Distinguish 'HPA raised replicas but pods Pending' (capacity) from 'HPA not raising' (metrics).

patterns.title: Pod cannot mount/attach its volume
detection: FailedScheduling mentioning persistentvolumeclaim / volume node affinity conflict / unbound PVC
ContainerCreating with FailedAttachVolume "Multi-Attach error" or FailedMount "timed out waiting for the volume"
root_causes: PVC Pending (see pvc-pending)
RWO volume still attached to the previous node (Multi-Attach)
zone mismatch between pod and zonal disk
CSI node/controller plugin unhealthy
diagnostics: kubectl get pvc -n <ns>; kubectl get pv

remediation.when: Multi-Attach error and the old node is gone/NotReady - attach is retried on the new node
PVC/StorageClass/CSI problem - data safety

patterns.verification: pod Running; no FailedMount events for 10 min
patterns.notes: StatefulSets on slow storage produce liveness failures that look like app crashes.

patterns.title: Readiness/liveness probe failing
detection: events Unhealthy "Readiness probe failed" / "Liveness probe failed"
pod Running but READY 0/1 for minutes; liveness restarts correlated across many pods
root_causes: liveness probe checks external dependencies -> cascading restarts when a dependency is slow
initialDelaySeconds/timeoutSeconds too short for a slow starter
probe path/port wrong after a change
readiness depends on DNS while CoreDNS is unhealthy

remediation.when: many pods fail probes at once (dependency problem) - restarting worsens the thundering herd
the probe definition changed in the newest revision
thresholds/paths need tuning

patterns.verification: Unhealthy events stop; READY n/n; restartCount flat
patterns.notes: Rule: liveness = internal process only; readiness = dependencies. 50 pods x liveness->DB turned a 10s DB blip into a multi-hour outage.

patterns.title: Evicted / failed pods left behind
detection: phase Failed, reason Evicted / Shutdown / NodeAffinity / UnexpectedAdmissionError
root_causes: node DiskPressure / MemoryPressure / ephemeral-storage overuse (see node-pressure)
node shutdown or preemption

remediation.when: always safe; the controller already replaced them

patterns.verification: no Failed pods remain in the namespace
patterns.notes: Many evictions at once point at a node hygiene problem, not an application bug.

patterns.title: Pod stuck Terminating
detection: metadata.deletionTimestamp older than the threshold
root_causes: finalizer from a controller that is gone
kubelet on the node is NotReady/unreachable
container ignores SIGTERM and volume unmount hangs

remediation.when: node is gone/NotReady and the pod is not part of a StatefulSet
a finalizer must be inspected by a human or the pod belongs to a StatefulSet

patterns.notes: Force-deleting StatefulSet pods risks two instances writing to the same volume.

patterns.title: Init container failing
detection: initContainerStatuses waiting.reason CrashLoopBackOff/Error; pod stuck Init:x/y
root_causes: dependency wait loop never succeeds (DB, migration, service DNS)
wrong image/command in the init container
permissions on a shared volume

remediation.when: the dependency the init container waits for is now available
the init container changed in the newest revision
the dependency itself is down

patterns.verification: pod leaves Init phase; READY n/n

patterns.title: Container cannot start (RunContainerError / ContainerCannotRun)
detection: waiting.reason RunContainerError / ContainerCannotRun / StartError
root_causes: entrypoint not found or not executable (exit 126/127)
volume mount path conflicts / read-only filesystem
runtime/seccomp/SELinux denial

remediation.when: introduced by the newest revision
the image or command is wrong

patterns.title: Pod rejected by SecurityContextConstraints
detection: ReplicaSet FailedCreate "unable to validate against any security context constraint"
Deployment ReplicaFailure=True while zero pods exist
root_causes: manifest assumes root / privileged / hostPath / hostNetwork / extra capabilities
ServiceAccount not bound to the SCC the workload needs
diagnostics: oc get scc; oc adm policy who-can use scc privileged

remediation.when: the previous revision was admitted
the workload legitimately needs an SCC - security decision

patterns.notes: The denial is usually correct behaviour; fix the manifest before widening SCCs.

patterns.title: Deployment rollout stuck (ProgressDeadlineExceeded)
detection: Deployment Progressing=False reason ProgressDeadlineExceeded
new ReplicaSet pods not becoming Ready while the old one still serves
root_causes: any pod-level failure on the new ReplicaSet
maxUnavailable=0 with no spare capacity; PDB blocking; quota exhausted

remediation.when: users are impacted and the previous revision was healthy - do not delay
pods are stale after a transient failure and the manifest is believed good
the failing pod pattern needs a manifest fix

patterns.notes: Classify by the failing pod's reason first, then apply that pattern; rollback is a first-class primitive.

patterns.title: Controller cannot create pods (quota / LimitRange / admission)
detection: Deployment ReplicaFailure=True; ReplicaSet FailedCreate "exceeded quota", "must specify limits", "admission webhook ... denied", "forbidden"
root_causes: ResourceQuota sized below the rollout surge (resource-quota)
LimitRange rejects missing/oversized requests (limit-range)
admission webhook backend down with failurePolicy Fail (admission-webhook)
ServiceAccount missing or RBAC/PSA rejection

remediation.when: cause is resource-quota and lowering replicas temporarily restores service
quota/LimitRange/webhook needs a human change

patterns.notes: A webhook with failurePolicy Fail blocks pod creation cluster-wide while existing pods keep running.

patterns.title: Workload has zero available replicas
detection: Deployment/StatefulSet with desired > 0 and availableReplicas == 0 without a more specific pod finding
root_causes: pods deleted/evicted and not recreated; scheduler starvation; controller manager issue

remediation.when: no pods exist or they are wedged without a clearer reason
evidence is insufficient

patterns.title: Service selector matches no pods
detection: Service with a selector that matches zero pods in its namespace (EndpointSlice empty)
root_causes: workload scaled to zero or deployed to another namespace
targetPort != containerPort (not detected here; check when 503s persist)

remediation.when: always - fixing a selector is a manifest change

patterns.verification: EndpointSlice has Ready endpoints; curl via the Service returns 200
patterns.notes: 502 = bad upstream response, 503 = no healthy upstream, 504 = upstream timeout.

patterns.title: Job reached backoffLimit
detection: Job condition Failed=True reason BackoffLimitExceeded / DeadlineExceeded
root_causes: application error, bad input, missing config, OOM

remediation.when: always - re-running a Job is an owner decision

patterns.title: Node NotReady / kubelet not posting status
detection: Node Ready=False/Unknown, reason NodeStatusUnknown "Kubelet stopped posting node status"
taint node.kubernetes.io/unreachable; pods on node Terminating/Unknown after ~5 min
root_causes: kubelet crash/OOM (containers may keep running)
firewall blocking 10250 / API 6443; VPC route change
node OOM / disk full; cloud instance stopped or throttled
diagnostics: oc debug node/<node> -- chroot /host systemctl status kubelet

remediation.when: the node flaps Ready/NotReady and keeps attracting pods
the node must be emptied - PDBs and local storage need judgement
kubelet restart / node reboot / network change is required

patterns.notes: Blocked port 10250 made every worker NotReady while apps kept serving.

patterns.title: Node under Memory/Disk/PID pressure
detection: Node condition MemoryPressure / DiskPressure / PIDPressure = True
root_causes: container logs not rotated; image cache growth; emptyDir abuse
missing ephemeral-storage limits; inode exhaustion
memory-hungry pods without requests
diagnostics: kubectl get pods -A --field-selector status.phase=Failed | grep Evicted

remediation.when: evicted pods clutter namespaces on this node
pressure persists and new pods keep landing on the node
images must be pruned, disk resized or kubelet thresholds changed

patterns.verification: pressure condition False; no new evictions
patterns.notes: Many nodes under DiskPressure is a cluster-hygiene issue, not an app bug.

patterns.title: PersistentVolumeClaim Pending
detection: PVC phase Pending beyond threshold; events ProvisioningFailed / "storageclass not found" / "no persistent volumes available"
only WaitForFirstConsumer events -> informational (binding waits for a pod)
root_causes: StorageClass missing or misspelled; no dynamic provisioner
zone mismatch; storage quota exhausted; CSI controller down
cloud API permissions lost
diagnostics: kubectl get storageclass; kubectl get pv

remediation.when: always - StorageClass/PV/CSI changes are human decisions

patterns.notes: emptyDir used for database data is irreversible loss on reschedule.

patterns.title: HPA cannot fetch metrics
detection: HPA ScalingActive=False reason FailedGetResourceMetric / FailedGetExternalMetric; TARGETS <unknown>
root_causes: metrics-server absent or crashing
target pods lack CPU requests (utilization undefined)
wrong scaleTargetRef; external metrics adapter down

remediation.when: load is high and autoscaling is broken - set a manual bridge replica count
metrics-server / requests must be fixed

patterns.notes: HPA object exists != autoscaling works. Queue-based workloads lag CPU; consider KEDA.

patterns.title: CertificateSigningRequests pending approval
detection: CSRs with no Approved/Denied condition older than 10 min (kubelet client/serving signers)
root_causes: cluster restored/powered on after cert rotation; new node joined while approver disabled
machine-approver rate limited; nodes added outside machine-api

remediation.when: always - approving a certificate is a trust decision

patterns.title: ClusterOperator Degraded or not Available
detection: oc get co shows AVAILABLE=False or DEGRADED=True
ClusterVersion Failing=True; alerts ClusterOperatorDegraded/ClusterOperatorDown
root_causes: operand pods CrashLoop; node/MCP issues; expired certificates
storage for the operand missing (image-registry); misconfigured operator CR; partial upgrade
diagnostics: oc get co; oc describe co <name>
oc get pods -n openshift-<name>-operator; oc logs -n openshift-<name>-operator deploy/<name>-operator --tail=200

remediation.when: always - collect `oc adm inspect` / must-gather and page a human

patterns.notes: Every part of the cluster is a Cluster Operator; each operator is just another container whose logs can be read.

patterns.title: MachineConfigPool degraded or stuck Updating
detection: oc get mcp DEGRADED=True or DEGRADEDMACHINECOUNT>0; UPDATING=True for hours
node annotation machineconfiguration.openshift.io/state=Degraded, reason "failed to drain node"
root_causes: drain blocked by PDB or local-storage pod
bad MachineConfig (invalid ignition, conflicting files)
node failed to reboot/rejoin; rpm-ostree deployment mismatch
diagnostics: oc debug node/<node> -- chroot /host rpm-ostree status

remediation.when: always - report which PDB or MachineConfig blocks progress

patterns.notes: CoreOS nodes have no package manager; verify with rpm-ostree.

patterns.title: Cluster DNS (CoreDNS) failure or overload
detection: app logs NXDOMAIN / SERVFAIL / "i/o timeout" across many namespaces
coredns pods OOMKilled/CrashLoop in kube-system (openshift-dns on OpenShift); ClusterOperator dns Degraded
root_causes: CoreDNS OOMKilled or too few replicas
bad Corefile
NetworkPolicy blocking port 53
ndots:5 amplification
conntrack exhaustion
diagnostics: kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=kube-dns -o wide

remediation.when: plain Kubernetes only, coredns pods wedged; on OpenShift the DNS operator owns it (never touch)
Corefile/upstream/NetworkPolicy changes are needed

patterns.notes: DNS is the single most recurring shared-infra failure on k8s.af.

patterns.title: NetworkPolicy blocks legitimate traffic
detection: timeouts (not refused) between namespaces right after a policy change; DNS failing only in default-deny namespaces
root_causes: default-deny without DNS egress allow
wrong namespaceSelector/podSelector
wrong policyTypes

remediation.when: always - revert via GitOps

patterns.notes: Cluster-scoped network policy, CNI, admission and DNS config are blast-radius multipliers.

patterns.title: RBAC Forbidden
detection: "Error from server (Forbidden)" in controller logs; CrashLoop right after a RoleBinding change
root_causes: missing Role/RoleBinding
wrong namespace in binding
ClusterRole vs Role scope

remediation.when: always

patterns.notes: Never auto-widen RBAC; over-broad RBAC appears in most incident stories.

patterns.title: Admission webhook down with failurePolicy Fail
detection: FailedCreate "failed calling webhook ... connection refused / no endpoints available"; new pods blocked cluster-wide
root_causes: webhook backend crashed or scaled to zero
expired serving cert
caBundle mismatch
webhook matching its own namespace

remediation.when: the webhook backend Deployment is wedged
failurePolicy or certificates must change

patterns.title: TLS certificate expiry
detection: "x509: certificate has expired"; cert-manager Certificate Ready=False; KubeClientCertificateExpiration alerts
root_causes: CA never rotated
kubelet rotation disabled
issuer broken
pending CSRs after power-off

remediation.when: always

patterns.title: Removed API after cluster upgrade
detection: "no matches for kind X in version Y"; GitOps sync failing right after upgrade
root_causes: manifests/Helm charts pin removed apiVersions; operators built against removed APIs

remediation.when: always - manifests must be updated

patterns.title: etcd / API server latency or NOSPACE
detection: etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds p99 > 10ms; "mvcc: database space exceeded"; kubectl timeouts; ClusterOperator etcd Degraded
root_causes: slow disk
db over quota without compaction
too many objects/events
burstable instances
large LIST calls

remediation.when: always

patterns.notes: etcd appears in 15+ k8s.af incidents.

patterns.title: PodDisruptionBudget blocks drain/upgrade
detection: drain output "Cannot evict pod as it would violate the pod's disruption budget"
MachineConfigPool stuck Updating; PDB status.disruptionsAllowed == 0
root_causes: minAvailable == replicas
replicas=1 with minAvailable=1
unhealthy replicas already violating the budget

remediation.when: adding one replica lets the drain proceed
the PDB itself must be relaxed

patterns.title: OpenShift ingress controller / router unhealthy
detection: co ingress Degraded; router-default pods not Ready; Routes return 503 "Application is not available"
root_causes: router capacity/placement
backend Service without endpoints
invalid route TLS
default cert expiry
diagnostics: oc -n openshift-ingress-operator get ingresscontroller default -o yaml

remediation.when: always (operator-managed namespace is excluded from auto-heal scope)

patterns.title: OpenShift authentication operator degraded
detection: co authentication Degraded; oc login fails on .well-known/oauth-authorization-server; console login loops
root_causes: ingress down
default ingress cert invalid
IdP unreachable
oauth-openshift pods CrashLoop
diagnostics: oc get co authentication ingress dns

remediation.when: always

patterns.notes: Fallback access when auth is broken - kubeconfig on a control-plane node.

patterns.title: Workload hardening gaps (preventive)
detection: mutable/untagged image; missing cpu/memory requests or memory limit; no readinessProbe; single replica; multi-replica without PDB
root_causes: manifests written without production defaults

remediation.when: always - included in the posture digest, never acted on

patterns.notes: These are the anti-patterns behind most of the incidents above; fix them before they page you.

posture_checks.why: split-brain deployments on scale-up; silent rollback failure
scheduler blind; BestEffort evicted first; HPA cannot compute
upgrades evict without protection, or drains deadlock when minAvailable == replicas
cascading restart storms; traffic to unready pods
all replicas on one failing node/zone
SIGKILL interrupts in-flight work during drains
emptyDir for data = loss; zonal PVs need WaitForFirstConsumer
removed APIs break deploys after upgrade
